Title: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) resource provider on Azure Stack preview

Body.Content:
The private preview of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) on Azure Stack Hub is now available. The same service that’s currently found in Azure will be available in Azure Stack Hub. You’ll be able to manage Kubernetes clusters in the same way you currently do in Azure. It will provide the same user experience, CLI, and API.

Learn more and see how to participate in the private preview
